title: Complementary base pairing in DNA and RNA
body: In DNA, adenine pairs with thymine and cytosine pairs with guanine via hydrogen bonds; in RNA, adenine pairs with uracil.

items.meaning: DNA contains deoxyribose; RNA contains ribose

items.label: Base
items.meaning: DNA contains uracil; RNA contains thymine

items.label: Strandedness
items.meaning: DNA is typically double stranded; RNA is typically single stranded

control: hook expansion contradicts the CED (1.7.A.4 secondary structure is local folding into alpha-helices and beta-pleated sheets; 1.7.A.5 tertiary is the three-dimensional shape. The hook swaps them.) The entry is correct, so only the hook should be rejected.
title: The four levels of protein structure
body: All four levels of protein structure determine the function of a protein.

items.label: Primary
items.meaning: the specific sequence of amino acids in the polypeptide

items.label: Secondary
items.meaning: local folding from interactions between backbone atoms, forming alpha-helices and beta-pleated sheets

items.label: Tertiary
items.meaning: the three-dimensional shape from hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic and ionic interactions, or disulfide bridges

expands_to.means: secondary: the overall three-dimensional shape of the protein
tertiary: local folding into alpha-helices and beta-pleated sheets

hooks.when_to_use: when listing the levels of protein structure in order
hooks.caution: Name each level in CED terms in an answer.
